name: Image-native Lokapurusha / Man-grid bilateral fold

observed_structure: upper stepped/dense lattice split into left and right halves
lower stepped/dense lattice split into left and right halves
bilateral reflection about the central vertical axis

reconstruction_rule.word_projection: Lay a phonetic sequence laterally on one side. A literal vertical fold maps positions to the opposite side. Read in the same left-to-right convention after folding, so the spatial sequence is reversed.
reconstruction_rule.ipa_operation: reverse the raw IPA token sequence only
reconstruction_rule.orthographic_operation: reverse the normalized written sequence only

explicit_exclusions: No place, manner, voicing or stop/fricative substitutions
No old reconstructed-language forms are used as evidence
research_boundary: The manuscript image itself does not provide phonetic labels for individual cells. Therefore the only phonetic transform admitted here is the bilateral geometric fold that is visibly present. Any cell-to-phoneme assignment would be invented and is deliberately excluded.
